notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092025/14f633060ad91242080ea9a3ed57de304875eaba.png[/img]

[h1]Try out the updated demo!😊[/h1]

We're excited to announce our new visual direction and updated demo! We've been hard at work over the last few months polishing, and we hope you take a look. We also updated the steam page with new screenshots.

P.S. - The update image is a sneak peak of our mage character + second floor! Also, try moving the shuffling the cards in game - the parallax effects are 🔥

notes.title: Minor demo update!
notes.content:
Happy 2025!

We pushed an update to the demo, so please take a look! We got a lot of feedback since our demo launch last month that we greatly appreciate. We hope this update will allow more players to complete the demo. Some notable changes:

[list]
[*] Updated UIs (Health, fonts, enemy full damage shown on hover)
[*] Minor rebalancing for cards, relics and enemies
[*] "Demo" starter deck with "Knight's Pledge" and some cards starting at level 2. We want players to see more of the fun parts of this game.
[*] Bug squashing!
[/list]

We're also working on a bigger visual update that we hope to reveal later this year. Cheers!

notes.title: Everglyph Trials Demo launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45092025/d0341565baf169b5446977a9709c0a99a7cd5905.png[/img]

[h1]🎉Woot Demo! 🎉[/h1]

After a bunch of work, we are really excited to announce our demo launch! You can play through one of the characters through the first floor.

Behind the scenes, we've revamped and updated a bunch of UI & graphics, and also a bunch of game implementation and playtesting. 

Let us know what you think! We'll continue to work hard towards our release in 2025.
